culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Tomoko Hirota. Conan figures out the truth and traps her by hiding nearby waiting for her to return to Kanae's house at night and asks her: «Why're you here so late». He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae. She murdered Kanae before 8am that morning after Kanae finished preparing her breakfast.

motive.zhHans: 江户川柯南告诉他们他是对的，但毛利小五郎来不了，所以他把孩子们带到了那里。她抗议说，牵引绳上拴着的狗是她的，但那其实是 Matsunosuke，因为小岛元太喊它去接飞盘，而只有 Matsunosuke 会追着飞盘跑。
motive.en: Conan told them that he was right but that Kogoro couldn't come because so he brought the kids there. She protests and says the dog tied to her leash is hers but it is in fact Matsunosuke because Genta yells him to come get the frisbee and only Matsunosuke would run after it.

method.zhHans: 在那之后，她把事先准备好的 Shinpei 的头巾留在了前门口，然后带着 Matsunosuke 伪装成 Kanae 去散步，制造目击者看到 Kanae 当天遛了 Matsunosuke 的假象，从而确立自己的不在场证明。如果她走完整条路线，就无法确立不在场证明了。所以，她直接带着 Matsunosuke 回到自己家，并遇到一个被她叫住的人，以此完成不在场证明。Hirota 回答说没有证据，但江户川柯南立刻打断了她，指出证据就在她旁边：被她调包的那只狗，真正的 Matsunosuke。
method.en: After that, she left Shinpei's bandana which she prepared earlier by the front door and went for a walk with Matsunosuke disguised as Kanae to create eyewitness that Kanae walked Matsunosuke that day establishing her alibi. If she'd walked the whole route, she wouldn't be able to establish her alibi. So, she directly went back to her house with Matsunosuke and met with someone she called out to complete her alibi. Hirota replies by saying there is no proof but Conan immediately stops her and points to the proof right by her side: the dog she swapped, the real Matsunosuke.

evidence.zhHans: 然后他告诉她，他们已经查出真正杀死 Kanae 的人是谁了。她本来很容易就会被发现，但她靠着带着那只狗骗过了所有人。正如 Tomoko 所说，她带着 Matsunosuke 的兄弟，这与证据吻合。Hirota 回答说没有证据，但江户川柯南立刻打断了她，指出证据就在她旁边：被她调包的那只狗，真正的 Matsunosuke。
evidence.en: He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae. She could've been found really easily but fooled everyone by having the dog with her. As Tomoko said, she had Matsunosuke's brother which coincide with the evidence. Hirota replies by saying there is no proof but Conan immediately stops her and points to the proof right by her side: the dog she swapped, the real Matsunosuke.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Tomoko Hirota。江户川柯南推理出真相并设下陷阱，躲在附近等她深夜回到 Kanae 的房子，然后问她：«你怎么这么晚还在这里»。接着他告诉她，他们已经查出真正杀死 Kanae 的人是谁了。那天早上在 Kanae 准备好早餐之后、8 点之前，她杀死了 Kanae。然后，她清理掉 Kanae 准备好的早餐，穿上刚从干洗店取回来的外套，让人以为她是在遛狗之后被杀的。在那之后，她把事先准备好的 Shinpei 的头巾留在了前门口，然后带着 Matsunosuke 伪装成 Kanae 去散步，制造目击者看到 Kanae 当天遛了 Matsunosuke 的假象。
resolution.en: The culprit is Tomoko Hirota. Conan figures out the truth and traps her by hiding nearby waiting for her to return to Kanae's house at night and asks her: «Why're you here so late». He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae. She murdered Kanae before 8am that morning after Kanae finished preparing her breakfast. Then, she cleaned away the breakfast she prepared and put on her coat that had just come back from the cleaners to make it look like she had been killed after walking her dog. After that, she left Shinpei's bandana which she prepared earlier by the front door and went for a walk with Matsunosuke disguised as Kanae to create eyewitness that Kanae walked Matsunosuke that day establishing her alibi.

summary.en: Conan and his friends were playing Frisbee at the park, when a dog named Matsunosuke launched off of Conan's head and caught the Frisbee. Matsunosuke's owner, Kanae Asakawa, apologized and took Conan's jacket in order to get it cleaned after Matsunosuke left dirt all over it. The next day when Conan and the Detective Boys arrived at her house to get the jacket they met Kanae's friend Tomoko and see Matsunosuke in his dog house, asleep.
